Why being someone's better half may not be love.

Kevin Trudeau says you shouldn't want a partner to be your better half. Each person should be whole, not needing the other.

Together, he says, two whole people create a new entity called us. If you are fine on your own, you don't need a partner clinging to you.

Kevin says a power couple comes from feeling good about who you are, not needing anything to complete you.

Do you see a partner as your other half or as a teammate?

Why a flashy jet may be nothing but a rented prop.

Kevin Trudeau recalls the infomercial days, when guys sold courses while standing in front of a jet and a Rolls Royce. They didn't own either. They hired the car for the photo shoot and put a sticker with their name on the plane.

He says plenty of people were making a lot of money a few years ago and are broke today, and nobody wants to talk about that.

Kevin's point is that wealth comes down to longevity, not the next shiny thing.

Have you ever been fooled by a flashy lifestyle online?
